scripts.dev: pnpm dev:web && concurrently 'pnpm dev:inpage' 'pnpm dev:inject' 'pnpm dev:background'
scripts.build: pnpm build:web && pnpm build:onboarding && concurrently 'pnpm build:inpage' 'pnpm build:inject' 'pnpm build:background'
scripts.watch: pnpm build:web --watch && concurrently 'pnpm build:inpage --watch' 'pnpm build:inject --watch' 'pnpm build:background --watch'
scripts.build:firefox: BROWSER=firefox pnpm build && node scripts/swap-manifest.mjs build-firefox
scripts.dev:firefox: BROWSER=firefox pnpm dev:web && node scripts/swap-manifest.mjs build-firefox && BROWSER=firefox concurrently 'pnpm dev:inpage' 'pnpm dev:inject' 'pnpm dev:background'
scripts.zip: pnpm build && mkdir -p zip && cd build && zip -r ../zip/walletchan-v$(node -p "require('../package.json').version").zip .
scripts.zip:cws: pnpm build && bash scripts/strip-cws-keys.sh && mkdir -p cws-zip && cd build && zip -r ../cws-zip/walletchan-v$(node -p "require('../package.json').version").zip .
scripts.zip:firefox: pnpm build:firefox && mkdir -p zip && cd build-firefox && zip -r ../zip/walletchan-firefox-v$(node -p "require('../package.json').version").zip .
scripts.sign:firefox: pnpm build:firefox && web-ext sign --source-dir build-firefox --artifacts-dir build-firefox/signed --api-key $WEB_EXT_API_KEY --api-secret $WEB_EXT_API_SECRET --channel listed
